items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: So they put me on with Jules Hermebol, I remember we had a five piece band and we worked all day.

ctx.x: And, he said, 'I'm the musical director, gonna be musical director, he was working town, I guess, at that time. So they put me on with Jules Hermebol, I remember we had a five piece band and we worked all day.
